more_info.overview: Candelilla wax is a purified wax from the leaves of the candelilla plant, Euphorbia antisyphilitica. It forms a surface coating that gives the food a shiny appearance or provides a protective finish. Purified wax obtained from the leaves of the candelilla plant. It is plant derived. The specified wax is hard and has yellowish-brown colouring. The specification describes it as effectively insoluble in water.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain cocoa and Chocolate products as covered by Directive 2000/36/EC; other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; chewing gum; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; coffee, coffee extracts; sweet baked goods.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.origin: Purified wax obtained from the leaves of the candelilla plant. It is plant derived.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The specified starting material is plant derived and compatible with vegetarian and vegan diets. The specification does not establish halal or kosher certification.
